title: Coast Guard Rescues 2 Aboard Disabled Sailboat
description: U.S. Coast Guard crews from Sector San Diego and Station San Diego worked together to rescue two people from a disabled sailboat approximately 1.5 miles south of Point Loma, Nov. 4, 2014. The people aboard the sailboat signaled to an MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew who were in the area on a training flight and a 45-foot Response Boat crew was called in to tow the boat to safety. U.S. Coast Guard video by Sector San Diego.
